title: Backups
description: Scheduled restic backups of all sites and databases to any SFTP server, for example a Hetzner Storage Box, a NAS or another Linux server.
started: Backup started. It runs in the background; reload this page to see the result.

status.title: Status
status.notSetUpText: Not set up yet: set a target and confirm its host key.
status.overdueText: No backup has finished in the last {{hours}} hours, although backups run {{every}}. Check the timer on the server with systemctl status hostashi-backup.timer.
status.removed_one: Removed {{count}} snapshot of the deleted site {{site}}.
status.removed_other: Removed {{count}} snapshots of the deleted site {{site}}.
status.removedExpired_one: Removed {{count}} snapshot of the deleted site {{site}} (expired).
status.removedExpired_other: Removed {{count}} snapshots of the deleted site {{site}} (expired).
status.removeFailed: Removing backups of deleted sites failed: {{error}}

target.title: Target and schedule
target.hostHint: DNS name or IP address of the SSH server.
target.portStorageBox: Right for a Hetzner Storage Box.
target.portStorageBoxWrong: Hetzner Storage Boxes serve SFTP on port 23.
target.directoryHint: Relative to the login directory, or absolute with a leading /. Created on the first run.
target.keepHint: The newest snapshot of each hour, day, week, month and year is kept, up to these counts. Hourly only matters when backups run more than once a day.
target.deletedDaysHint: The snapshots of a deleted site are removed this many days after its last snapshot. 0 keeps them until you delete them.
target.windowHint: The daily backup starts at a random time in this window, server time.
target.intervalHint: Backups start at a fixed random minute after each of these hours, counted from midnight, server time. A backup that is still running when the next one is due skips that one.
target.readPartsHint: Each month 1 of these parts is read back and checked. 0 turns it off.
target.addKey: Add this key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the SFTP account.
target.addKeyStorageBox: On a Hetzner Storage Box you can also add it in Hetzner's console under SSH keys.

hostKey.title: Host key
hostKey.unconfirmed: The server's SSH host key is not confirmed yet. Backups start once it is.
hostKey.compare: The target presents {{fingerprint}}. Compare it with the fingerprint of the server: run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub on that server, or ask your provider. Trust it only if it matches.
hostKey.compareStorageBox: The target presents {{fingerprint}}. Compare it with the fingerprint of the server: run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub on that server, or ask your provider (Hetzner publishes the fingerprints of its Storage Boxes). Trust it only if it matches.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.earlierNote: These snapshots are from an earlier site named {{site}}, from before the current site was created. Only administrators see them. A restore writes into a new directory restore-<time> in the home of the current site.
snapshots.deletedNote: The site {{site}} was deleted; its snapshots stay until you delete them. A restore writes into a new directory restore-<time> in the home of the site you pick and never changes live files.
snapshots.note: A restore writes into a new directory restore-<time> in the site's home and never changes the live site.
snapshots.restoredFilesOf_one: Restored {{count}} file into {{dir}} of the site {{site}}.
snapshots.restoredFilesOf_other: Restored {{count}} files into {{dir}} of the site {{site}}.
snapshots.createSiteFirst: Create a site first to restore these snapshots into.
snapshots.empty: No snapshots of this site yet.

delete.markedText: The next backup run removes all snapshots of this site. Back up now removes them at once. Until then you can keep them.
delete.markedTextEarlier: The next backup run removes the earlier site's snapshots. Back up now removes them at once. Until then you can keep them.
delete.title: Delete backups
delete.hint: The next backup run removes all snapshots of this site ({{n}}). Once removed, they cannot be restored.
delete.hintEarlier: The next backup run removes the earlier site's snapshots ({{n}}). Once removed, they cannot be restored.

import.needPostgres: This is a PostgreSQL dump. Add a PostgreSQL server under Databases to import it.
import.done: The dump is in the new database {{name}}. Point the site to it when you have checked it.

errors.unreachable: The backup target did not answer over SSH. Check host and port.
errors.running: A backup run is in progress.
errors.restore_running: A restore is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
errors.database_exists: A database with this name exists. Choose a new name.
errors.database_not_new: A restored dump only goes into a new database.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.target_not_found: The site to restore into does not exist.
errors.confirm_mismatch: Type the site's name to confirm.
errors.source_exists: A site of this name exists. Restore its earlier snapshots into that site.
